figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 1. Construction of the 3–carene–producing yeast strain. (a) Construction of the 3–carene synthesis pathway. Acetyl coenzyme A, acetyl coenzyme A; HMG–CoA, 
hydroxymethylglutaryl–CoA reductase; IPP, isopentenyl pyrophosphate; DMAPP, dimethyl allyl pyrophosphate; ERG20, farnesyl diphosphate synthase; GPP, geranyl 
pyrophosphate; CarTS, 3–carene synthase. (b) Titers of 3–carene of the strains yWFY02 and yWFY03. The error line represents the average standard error of three 
independent repeated experiments. The black dots indicate the OD600; ∗ ∗ denotes p < 0.01. (c) Results from the gas chromatography analysis of the 3–carene standard, 
yWFY02 and yWFY03 extract. (d) Mass spectra of the 3–carene standard and the compound with a retention time of 6.879 min in extracts of strain yWFY02.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 2. The introduction of orthogonal pathway and the truncation of CarTS. (a) Two synthetic pathways for the formation of 3–carene from IPP and DMAPP were 
constructed. The traditional pathway comprises ERG20WW and CarTS, and the NPP orthogonal pathway consists of SlNDPS1 and CarTS. (b) The titers of 3–carene 
generated by CarTS from diﬀerent sources in the traditional and orthogonal paths were measured. The frame on the left represents the degree of proximity between 
CarTS relatives from diﬀerent sources. GPPS represents the traditional way to introduce ERG20WW , and NPPS represents the orthogonal way to introduce SlNDPS1. 
The error line represents the standard error of the mean value of the three independent repeated tests. (c) The 3–carene titers of SsCarTS truncated at diﬀerent 
positions. The error line represents the standard error of the average of the three independent repeated tests. The black dots indicate the OD600 ; ∗ ∗ denotes p < 0.01. 
(d) The ﬂuorescence intensity of each OD600 at diﬀerent truncation positions was measured.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 3. Improvement in 3–carene production by subcellular localization of t39–SsCarTS. (a) Fluorescence localization map of yeast after co–expressing diﬀerent 
subcellular translocations of t39–SsCarTS-RFP and the subcellular marker protein GFP. KDEL, endoplasmic reticulum localization signal peptide; pPts1, peroxisome 
localization signal peptide; PLN1P, lipid titration signal peptide. GFP, cytoplasmic green ﬂuorescent marker protein; Sec61–GFP, endoplasmic reticulum green 
ﬂuorescent marker protein; Pex3–GFP, peroxisome green ﬂuorescent marker protein; PLN1P–GFP, lipid droplet green ﬂuorescent marker protein. Bright is the bright 
ﬁeld position where the yeast that turns oﬀthe ﬂuorescence exciter is located, and merge is the eﬀect of red ﬂuorescence and green ﬂuorescence coincidence. The 
scale of the image is 10 μm. (b) The titers of 3–carene located in diﬀerent subcellular localization were determined. The error line represents the standard error of 
the average of the three independent repeated tests. The black dots indicate the OD600 ; ∗ ∗ denotes p < 0.01.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 4. Screening of the molecular chaperones suitable for expression of Ss CarTS. (a) The titer of 3-carene with diﬀerent molecular chaperones was measured. Eight 
molecular chaperones were screened and co-expressed with Ss CarTS to generate 3-carene. The error line represents the average standard error of three independent 
repeated experiments. The black dots represent the OD600 values; ∗ ∗ denotes p < 0.01. (b) The ﬂuorescence intensity of each OD represents the expression level of 
Ss CarTS. yWFY31 without PDI1 and yWFY32 with PDI1 were compared to conﬁrm the expression of Ss CarTS.

figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 5. The engineered strain yWFY27 was expanded and cultured. Fed-batch 
fermentation of yWFY27 was performed in a 5-L fermenter using SC medium. 
The medium used was SC to monitor sugar and alcohol consumption every 3-5 
h. The OD600 and the titer of 3-carene were measured.
